Example-1 ◼ A home computer is connected to an ISP server through 56 Kbps modem. Given a frame size of 5600 bits, compute P-Delay and T-Delay for the link. Assume speed of signal = 2/3 C and length of the link is 5 km. T-delay = 5600 (bits)/ 56 000 (bps) = 100 m sec ◼ P-delay = 5 (km)/200000 (km/s) = 0.025 m sec ◼ Latency = 100.025 m sec ◼ 8
